_comment: Durable, git-tracked changelog of Brubru knowledge-base activity. Powers the 'What's new' feed in MEUB > Brubru Databases > Knowledge Guides. Append via scripts/kb_changelog.py (never hand-edit unless fixing). Newest entries FIRST. action: 'added' | 'updated' | 'canon' | 'deep_dive'.

entries.title: EU Sanctions Implementation Framework
entries.summary: 21st Russia sanctions package proposed 9 Jun 2026 (shadow fleet +30 vessels, first-time targeting of assisting vessels + crypto + fishing industry + entry ban on Russia-side fighters); not yet adopted

entries.title: Digital Markets Act
entries.summary: Commission imposed first-ever DMA Article 24 interim measures on Meta (9 Jun 2026): restore free WhatsApp access for rival AI assistants within 5 working days, in force until June 2029

entries.title: European Biotech Act
entries.summary: Added verified joint SANT-ITRE committee (Rule 58), rapporteurs Andriukaitis (S&D) and Beke (EPP), 13 shadows, ENVI/JURI opinions, the two precursor INI reports and the 19 March 2026 joint-committee presentation; replaced the stale 'no rapporteur appointed' status block.

entries.title: EU Health Security Framework (Health Union)
entries.summary: New guide: Reg 2022/2371 cross-border health threats + reinforced ECDC (2022/2370) + EMA (2022/123) + HERA + EWRS + Health Security Committee

entries.title: Union Customs Code Reform
entries.summary: Added the temporary EUR 3 customs duty on low-value imported parcels (Implementing Reg 2026/1200), bridging to the full reform's de minimis abolition.

entries.title: EU Fisheries Policy
entries.summary: Added the Commission's sustainable-fishing orientations for 2027 and the European Ocean Pact one-year review.

entries.title: EU Customs Reform
entries.summary: Added the temporary EUR 3 customs duty on low-value imported parcels (distance sales up to EUR 150), Implementing Reg 2026/1200.

entries.title: EFPIA pharma canon: 10 EU pharma laws
entries.summary: Ten core EU pharmaceutical laws shipped end to end: 10 Chat guides, 60 deep-dive pages (6 languages), 10 EU Law Comply clusters.

entries.title: Three framework directives canon
entries.summary: EECC, Solvency II and MiFID II shipped: 3 Chat guides, 18 deep-dive pages with transposition maps, 3 EU Law Comply clusters.

entries.title: European Semester
entries.summary: Added the 2026 Spring Package (country-specific recommendations, reformed Stability and Growth Pact dimension).
